title: Exactness of rows presented by additive Hom of distinguished triangles
statement: Let J be any small category and suppose the fixed-universe derived category of modules on every scheme exists. Let S be a five-term complex of J-indexed abelian-group diagrams and B a five-term complex of abelian groups. Suppose every evaluated short complex of S and every short complex of B is isomorphic to the ULift of additive Hom from an object M to a distinguished triangle T in the derived category of some scheme Z. Then S and B are exact.

source.place: Tag 08BW, Hom exact sequence of Mayer–Vietoris; Mathlib categorical exactness

proof.text: Additive coyoneda is homological, so its value on a distinguished triangle is exact. ULift preserves exactness; transfer along the given short-complex isomorphisms. Evaluation functors jointly reflect isomorphisms and preserve homology, hence jointly detect exactness. Apply this to each short complex of S, and use the same Hom-triangle argument directly for B. This is implemented with Functor.map_distinguished_exact, ShortComplex.Exact.map, ShortComplex.exact_of_iso, and JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.exact_iff.

proof_origin.place: Categorical Hom exactness and detection by evaluation

theorem perfect_hom_triangle_presented_rows_exact
    {J : Type u} [Category J]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (S : ComposableArrows (J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u w}) 4)
    (B : ComposableArrows AddCommGrpCat.{max u w} 4)
    (hS : S.IsComplex) (hB : B.IsComplex)
    (hstage : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 2 ≤ 4) (j : J),
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (T : Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
        (hT : T ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Z)),
        Nonempty (((S.sc hS r hr).map ((evaluation J AddCommGrpCat.{max u w}).obj j)) ≅
          (shortComplexOfDistTriangle T hT).map
            ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op M)) ⋙
              AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u})))
    (hlimit : ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 2 ≤ 4),
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Z)
        (T : Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
        (hT : T ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Z)),
        Nonempty ((B.sc hB r hr) ≅
          (shortComplexOfDistTriangle T hT).map
            ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op M)) ⋙
              AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u}))) :
    S.Exact ∧ B.Exact
